name: push_payment
description: Release an outbound payment, or hold it because the customer may be sending it to a scammer
subject: user
hold: Should this payment be held, and the customer spoken to, because the customer may be sending it under the direction or deception of a scammer, or because someone other than the customer is making it?

typologies.investment_scam: Investment or pig-butchering scam: a contact met online builds trust over weeks, shows fake profits, and the customer sends larger and larger amounts to an investment platform or a crypto account
typologies.romance_scam: Romance scam: an online partner the customer has never met asks for money again and again, for travel, a medical bill or a visa
typologies.impersonation_scam: Impersonation scam: a caller who claims to be the bank, the police or a government office tells the customer to move money to a safe account
typologies.purchase_scam: Purchase scam: the customer pays a stranger by bank transfer for goods that will not arrive, often from an online marketplace
typologies.invoice_redirection: Invoice redirection: a fake message from a real supplier, builder or solicitor gives new bank details for a payment the customer expects to make
typologies.account_takeover: Account takeover: someone other than the customer is using the account
typologies.legit: Legitimate payment by the customer for their own purposes

reasons.new_payee: The payee was added recently, in this visit or in the last few weeks
reasons.payee_name_mismatch: The name check on the payee account did not match, or only nearly matched, the name the customer typed
reasons.payee_reported: The payee also receives money from other customers who reported a scam, at a share above normal. A large exchange or business that many customers pay is not this unless that share is high.
reasons.escalating_payments: Payments to the same new payee or platform grew over the last weeks
reasons.money_came_back_first: A small amount came back from the payee or the platform before the larger payments, as a fake profit
reasons.funds_gathered_first: Savings, a new loan or money from other accounts was moved in shortly before the payment
reasons.call_during_visit: A phone call was active while the customer used the app
reasons.remote_access: A remote access or screen sharing app was running during the visit
reasons.details_pasted: The payee's details were pasted, not typed, often after switching to another app
reasons.warning_overridden: The customer answered a scam warning in a way that does not fit the payment, or stayed on it a long time and went on
reasons.answer_changed: The customer answered the same scam warning differently in an earlier visit
reasons.purpose_does_not_fit: The payment purpose the customer chose does not fit the payee or the history
reasons.limit_raised: The customer raised the payment limit in the visit or shortly before
reasons.coached_messages: Messages from the customer suggest that another person tells them what to do or what to say
reasons.unusual_amount: The amount is far above what the customer usually sends
reasons.takeover_signs: A new device, a password reset or a contact change came shortly before the payment. Reads by an app the customer linked earlier through a data aggregator are not a new device; a new app linked right after a password reset or a contact change is this
